- meshLocalPrefix.m8[0] = 0xfd
- meshLocalPrefix.m8[1..5] = first 5 bytes of ExtendedPanId = 0xde, 0xad, 0x00, 0xbe, 0xef
- meshLocalPrefix.m8[6] = 0x00
- meshLocalPrefix.m8[7] = 0x00

So mesh-local prefix = fd:dead:00be:ef00:0000::/64 = fdde:ad00:beef:0000::/64

The RLOC address is: mesh-local prefix + ::00ff:fe00:RLOC16
